You can't be out here stunning everyone!|[[Ruthie]] on Wave 17 ([[Victory Field]])|audio = AdidasMission3Wave17-1.ogg}} }} ==Description== The '''Goal Keeper''' was an enemy part of the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. It had high health and defense, and a relatively slow speed. It had one ability, ''Cone Strike'', where it targets a tower or unit in its range, stunning towers for 3 seconds and dealing 150 damage to units in its hit radius of 8 and attack angle of 160. ==Appearance== The '''Goal Keeper''' is a humanoid character with a floating cone head that has drawn eyes and mouth. It wears a cyan and orange Adidas T-shirt with stripes around sleeves, cyan and black shorts, and stylized gray, orange and white Adidas shoes. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |10% |2,000 |- !Wave !Health |- |18 |22,000 |- |19 |24,000 |- |20 |26,000 |} ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Backyard Legends Event]] is listed instead. *The [[Militant]] and [[Trapper]] can be quite effective at taking this out. **The [[Trapper]] is also capable of bypassing its [[Defense]]. **The [[Commander]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} GoalKeeperCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (22 May 2026 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} BackyardLegendsPI.png|'''Goal Keeper''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} BackyardLegendsIcon.png|'''Goal Keeper''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} GoalKeeperIconIG.png|'''Goal Keeper''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Goal Keeper''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. *The '''Goal Keeper''' reuses the [[Fallen Guardian]]'s ability. ==Update History== *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **'''Goal Keeper''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Goal Keeper's''' [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is completely empty. **{{Bug}} '''Goal Keeper''' is positioned sideways in the [[Index]]. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description has been corrected to no description available. *'''12 June 2026''' - [[V2.0.0|v2.0.9]] **'''Goal Keeper''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{VictoryField|[[Soccer Goal]]|Wave 14|Goal Keeper|Wave 17|[[Felipe]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
